警視廳統計書 1939

Keishichō tōkeisho (Statistical Report of the Metropolitan Police Board), 第49回, 昭和14年 (1939)
警視廳 (Metropolitan Police Board), 東京, 1941 (昭和16年刊行)

All 259 numbered tables are transcribed; the printed contents are given as the table of contents, and the chapter dividers are not reproduced. A slip pasted on the contents asks that the volume not be made public and be handled with care. Each spread was read once by Claude Sonnet 5.5 from full-resolution crops, with no checking by eye; three long lists (private hospitals, arrests by offence, summary judgments by offence) were read in sections by several readers and joined. Where a 3 could be an 8 and only one reading makes the printed total reconcile — the cell being the only doubtful one in that sum — that reading is used and noted. Printed totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted. 65 of about 224,000 filled cells could not be read and are marked [?].
